title: Head of Manufacturing - Promotional Products & Custom Manufacturing
text:
**Job Description - Head of Manufacturing- Promotional Products & Custom Manufacturing Company: Stealth Mode Three Department: Operations Location: Richmond, TX (On-site) Employment type: Full-time Compensation: $80,000–$120,000 per year Original apply URL: https://www.stealthmodethree.com/careers/job\_a46ed593ff5e48d59c33 About the Role We are seeking an experienced Head of Manufacturing to lead and scale our production operation in Richmond, Texas. This is not a traditional general-manufacturing management role. We are looking for a leader who understands the unique demands of the promotional products and custom merchandise industry — where every day can involve changing order volumes, customized products, tight deadlines, multiple production methods, material constraints, and constantly shifting priorities. The ideal candidate has experience leading production in promotional products, decorated apparel, custom merchandise, commercial printing, signage, embroidery, DTF/DTG, screen printing, heat transfer, or a similar high-mix production environment. You will own the operational performance of the manufacturing organization and work closely with leadership and other departments to build a reliable, scalable, high-performing production operation. As Head of Manufacturing, you will be responsible for translating customer demand into an efficient production operation. You will lead the people, processes, equipment, materials, and systems required to consistently deliver orders on time, at the expected quality, and at the right cost. You will be expected to identify bottlenecks before they become problems, establish clear accountability across the production team, and continuously improve how work moves through the facility. The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing a print shop or production environment and be comfortable taking ownership of production performance from start to finish. Responsibilities Production & Operations - Own daily production operations and overall manufacturing performance. - Plan and prioritize production based on order volume, deadlines, capacity, materials, and available labor. - Establish production schedules and adjust priorities as demand changes. - Monitor throughput, turnaround time, capacity utilization, labor efficiency, quality, and waste. - Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective actions. - Ensure orders move efficiently from intake through production, quality control, and fulfillment. People Leadership - Lead, develop, and hold production employees and supervisors accountable. - Establish clear expectations and performance standards. - Build a culture centered on ownership, urgency, quality, and continuous improvement. - Recruit and train production talent as the organization grows. - Develop cross-training and workforce-flexibility strategies to reduce production disruption. - Address performance issues quickly and fairly through coaching, documentation, and accountability. Promotional Products Manufacturing - Understand the operational requirements of customized and made-to-order products. - Coordinate different production methods, equipment, materials, and workflows. - Optimize production sequencing and batch similar work where appropriate. - Understand the impact of artwork, materials, production methods, finishing, and fulfillment on turnaround time and quality. - Work closely with other departments to ensure production requirements are understood before orders reach the floor. Quality & Continuous Improvement - Establish and maintain quality standards and production controls. - Identify root causes of defects, rework, delays, and production failures. - Develop SOPs, work instructions, checklists, and visual standards. - Implement process improvements that increase throughput while reducing waste and errors. - Establish meaningful KPIs and use data to drive operational decisions. Inventory, Equipment & Materials - Maintain appropriate inventory levels and production material availability. - Partner with purchasing and supply chain to anticipate material requirements. - Monitor material usage, waste, and production costs. - Coordinate equipment maintenance and respond quickly to equipment failures. - Develop contingency plans for equipment downtime and capacity constraints. Cross-Functional Leadership - Partner with Sales, Customer Service, Purchasing, Warehouse, and company leadership. - Establish clear communication around production capacity, deadlines, shortages, and delays. - Help ensure sales commitments align with actual production capacity. - Provide leadership with visibility into production performance and constraints. Requirements The strongest candidates will have: - 5+ years of production or manufacturing leadership experience. - Direct experience in promotional products, custom merchandise, decorated apparel, printing, signage, or a closely related industry. - Experience managing high-volume, customized or made-to-order production. - Experience managing production teams and supervisors. - Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, and capacity management. - Experience using KPIs to manage throughput, quality, labor, turnaround, waste, and cost. - Strong understanding of inventory and material planning. - Experience with equipment maintenance, downtime, and production contingencies. - Demonstrated process-improvement experience. - Experience creating and implementing SOPs. - Strong employee-management and accountability skills. - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. - A hands-on leadership style and willingness to spend significant time on the production floor. Preferred Industry Experience Experience with any of the following is highly valuable: - Promotional products - Branded merchandise - Custom apparel - DTF printing - DTG printing - Screen printing - Embroidery - Heat press / heat transfer - Digital printing - Large-format printing - Sign manufacturing - Custom merchandise production - Fulfillment of personalized or made-to-order products Schedule Ability to work full-time, Monday through Friday, on-site in Richmond, Texas. Benefits - $80,000–$120,000 annual salary - Leadership position with significant ownership and responsibility - Opportunity to help scale and improve a growing manufacturing operation - Collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment - Opportunity for long-term growth within the organization**

Pay: $80,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future? (Yes/No)
* Are you currently located in or willing to relocate to Richmond, TX for an on-site role? (Yes/No)
* Do you have professional experience with promotional products, DTF, DTG, screen printing, or embroidery? (Yes/No)
